name: ticket_lock-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only ticket_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 40000; exit $s
